name: WF-461 — Seller Response → Negotiation Loop / Contract Acceptance / Walk-Away Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const responseId=String(b.responseId??b.messageId??'').trim(); const responseText=String(b.responseText??b.message??'').trim(); const offerId=String(b.offerId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,portfolioId,dealId,responseId,responseText,offerId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Seller Negotiation Response').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const text=input.responseText.toLowerCase(); const dnc=ctx.dnc===true||ctx.suppressed===true; const blocked=ctx.closed===true||['closed','cancelled','disputed'].includes(String(ctx.dealStatus??'').toLowerCase()); const duplicate=ctx.responseAlreadyProcessed===true; const protectedMao=Number(ctx.protectedMAO??ctx.protectedMao??0); const currentOffer=Number(ctx.currentOffer??0); const latestOffer=Number(ctx.latestOffer??currentOffer); const rounds=Number(ctx.negotiationRound??ctx.round??0); const maxRounds=Math.max(1,Number(ctx.maxNegotiationRounds??5)); const sellerMotivation=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(ctx.motivationScore??50))); const intentRules=[['dnc',/(do not contact|stop contacting|remove me|unsubscribe|don't text|dont text)/],['accept',/^(yes|accept|accepted|deal|agreed|i agree|let's do it|lets do it)/],['counteroffer',/(counter|would take|i can do|take \$|for \$|price is)/],['reject',/(not interested|no thanks|pass|no deal|too low)/],['callback',/(call me|give me a call|talk on the phone)/],['nurture',/(later|not ready|next month|next year)/]]; let intent='other'; for(const [k,r] of intentRules){if(r.test(text)){intent=k;break;}} const mentioned=(text.match(/\$\s?([0-9,]+(?:\.\d+)?)/)||[])[1]; const counterAmount=mentioned?Number(String(mentioned).replace(/,/g,'')):0; let route='human_review'; let nextAction='review_response'; let status='review'; const flags=[]; if(dnc||intent==='dnc'){route='do_not_contact';nextAction='suppress_future_outreach';status='blocked';flags.push('dnc_or_suppressed');} else if(blocked){route='blocked_deal';nextAction='no_further_negotiation';status='blocked';flags.push('closed_or_blocked_deal');} else if(duplicate){route='duplicate_response';nextAction='do_not_reprocess';status='duplicate';flags.push('duplicate_response');} else if(intent==='accept'){route='contract_acceptance';nextAction='verify_final_economics_and_contract_readiness';status='accepted';} else if(intent==='counteroffer'){if(counterAmount>0&&protectedMao>0&&counterAmount<=protectedMao&&rounds<maxRounds){route='negotiation_loop';nextAction='evaluate_counteroffer_and_prepare_next_action';status='counteroffer_valid';} else if(counterAmount>protectedMao){route='walk_away_or_reengage';nextAction=sellerMotivation>=70?'reengage_without_exceeding_protected_mao':'walk_away_or_nurture';status='above_mao';flags.push('counteroffer_above_protected_mao');} else if(rounds>=maxRounds){route='human_review_or_walk_away';nextAction='max_negotiation_rounds_reached';status='round_limit';flags.push('max_negotiation_rounds_reached');} else {route='human_review';nextAction='verify_counteroffer_amount';status='review';flags.push('counteroffer_amount_missing_or_invalid');}} else if(intent==='reject'){route='walk_away_or_nurture';nextAction=sellerMotivation>=60?'schedule_reengagement':'close_lost_or_nurture';status='rejected';} else if(intent==='callback'){route='call_follow_up';nextAction='schedule_seller_call';status='callback_requested';} else if(intent==='nurture'){route='nurture';nextAction='schedule_reengagement';status='nurture';} const confidence=intent==='other'?40:90; const idempotencyKey='wf461:'+input.leadId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.responseId; return [{json:{...input,negotiationLoop:{intent,status,route,nextAction,counterAmount,currentOffer,latestOffer,protectedMAO:protectedMao,negotiationRound:rounds,maxNegotiationRounds:maxRounds,sellerMotivation,flags,requiresHumanReview:route==='human_review'||route==='human_review_or_walk_away',confidenceScore:confidence},idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {status:'blocked',reason:'leadId, portfolioId, dealId, responseId and responseText are required'} }}

meta.notes: Closes the seller-response negotiation loop by classifying acceptance, counteroffer, rejection, callback, nurture and DNC signals; enforcing protected MAO and maximum negotiation rounds; and routing toward contract readiness, another negotiation cycle, walk-away/re-engagement or human review. Production use requires verified seller-response classification, canonical MAO, negotiation history, contract-readiness schema and InsulaCRM API contracts.
